breaches.detail: The error message format for metadata buffer overflow has changed from a fixed string to a formatted string with %zu + %zu on %s placeholders and actual arguments. This confirms the OUTPUT_FORMAT_CHANGE finding. Any parser matching the exact old string will break.

contract_results.test_input: binary strings extraction from compiled tools/lvm
contract_results.notes: Format string change confirmed. The error message now includes contextual diagnostic data (size values and device name).
Normal CLI operation identical before/after. No behavioral regression for normal config read paths.
